newsitem.title: USA: NYMEX crude ends lower after losing earlier gains.
newsitem.headline: NYMEX crude ends lower after losing earlier gains.

text.p: NYMEX crude oil prices ended lower on Wednesday, having failed to hold gains made earlier in the day.
Benchmark light crude futures for April delivery hit a high of $20.89 a barrel during the regular session but slipped back to settle at $20.49, down 17 cents on the day.

"Again the market failed to follow through on strength yesterday," said Ed Kevelson, a trader at Paribas Futures in New York."Basically, the market said it didnt believe the numbers on crude," he added, referring data showing a heft draw on crude stocks last week.
